posts.title: October 2026 Earnings
posts.description: I spent October trying to push my books to rank before the big spending season starts. Which I think will be between mid-November and Christmas. This means my profits turned into losses, and I am now spending heavily on ads on books that have a good potential.

posts.title: September 2026 Earnings
posts.description: Better late than never right? I had a terrible month in September and I think that’s why I procrastinated writing this post. My last three book launches were either failures or not making money yet. I guess I am still too unexperienced, or maybe I am just unlucky. Or it could be both.

posts.title: August 2026 Earnings
posts.description: Some people slow down in August. I decided to take the time to improve my books, write more titles and get ready for Q4. I can confidently say that I am going to publish and launch 4 to 5 more books before the end of the year. And I hope these will do well in the coming holiday season.
